description: This file defines custom quantizable LSTM and RNN modules, including LSTMCell, LSTM, and related classes, with implementations to support decomposition into building blocks for quantization and deployment.

classes.name: LSTMCell
classes.description: A quantizable Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) cell that supports decomposition into building blocks for quantization.

classes.name: _LSTMSingleLayer
classes.description: A single unidirectional LSTM layer used internally in the larger LSTM module.

classes.name: _LSTMLayer
classes.description: A bidirectional LSTM layer composed of two _LSTMSingleLayer instances.

classes.name: LSTM
classes.description: A quantizable multi-layer LSTM module supporting multiple layers and bidirectionality.
